odung-hero.prompt:
[공통 규칙 — 모든 그림에 똑같이 적용]
참고 그림 (이 그림체와 캐릭터를 그대로 따라 그려 주세요)
오둥이: /Users/ryanmac/Time Stamp/assets/mascots/odung-camera-v2.png
퍼펭이: /Users/ryanmac/Time Stamp/assets/mascots/perpeng-camera-v2.png
그림체: 참고 그림과 같은 굵고 일정한 검정 외곽선(끝은 둥글게), 평면 채색. 그라데이션·질감·광택·3D 느낌 없음.
오둥이: 흰 몸, 주황 부리와 발, 동그란 흰 눈에 작은 검은 눈동자, 하늘색 카메라.
퍼펭이: 짙은 회청색 몸, 흰 얼굴과 배, 또렷한 눈썹, 분홍 볼, 노란 부리와 발, 민트색 카메라.
크기: 1024×1024 PNG, 배경은 완전히 투명 (흰 배경·체크무늬 아님).
바닥 그림자, 배경 장식, 테두리 없음. 글자·숫자·로고·기호 절대 넣지 않기.
그림은 가운데에, 사방 여백 약 8%. 어느 부분도 잘리지 않게.
개별 그림에서 명시한 반짝이, 땀방울, 시계 바늘과 점선만 장식 금지 규칙의 예외입니다.
Reference images have subtle shading: REMOVE it in these new illustrations. All color areas must be SOLID FLAT COLORS, not shaded, not textured, no gradients. Maintain the SAME character identities; two eyes always fully visible. On the penguin, simple flat white eye highlights are part of the established character identity, not glossy 3D shading. No cast shadows anywhere.

PRECISE LOCAL COMPOSITION EDIT of the attached completed odung-hero drawing. Preserve the character identity, facial features, body proportions, standing pose, foot baseline and scale. Fix ONLY the camera framing for an upper-two-thirds icon crop.
The ENTIRE CAMERA including its bottom edge must fit above y=65% of the full square canvas. Currently it hangs a little too low. Keep its WIDTH the same large width, but make the camera body modestly LESS TALL, like a natural wide compact camera, and move the camera and holding wings a little UP if needed. Target camera rectangular body between approximately y=46% and y=64%, lens centered at y=55%, lens circular and large at about 14% canvas diameter. Camera width about 36% canvas. Keep both flippers holding it naturally at its sides, both eyes, cheeks and whole bill entirely unobscured; no overlap of camera over face. The shutter may extend above camera body. Exactly one yellow sparkle at camera upper-right as currently.
Keep all other positions, full body, feet, head, face and framing essentially unchanged. Odung retains its SMALL BLUE ID tag below the camera. Do not add neck separation.
All fills flat solid colors, eliminate any residual gradients or texture. Preserve true transparent background. Output 1024 by 1024 square.
